en.tagline: Tencent COS storage and CI media and document processing
en.summary: This skill gives a developer one entry point for Tencent Cloud Object Storage (COS) and Data Processing Service (CI, 数据万象). It covers file and bucket management, image, document, media, content review, voice and knowledge base tasks. It runs as Node.js scripts that return JSON.
problem: Teams that keep files in Tencent Cloud COS often need more than upload and download. They also need image resizing, document conversion, content review, speech recognition or search over stored files. Each of these uses different COS and CI calls.
With this skill, storage and CI tasks run through the same scripts and share one set of credentials. Before a CI task runs, the skill checks whether that CI service is enabled on the bucket.
fit: Managing objects and buckets in COS from a script or agent
Resizing, cropping, watermarking or converting stored images
Converting Office files to PDF or previewing documents
Searching indexed images, videos or documents in a dataset
unfit: Deleting objects or buckets in strict mode (KIKI=1), which blocks all delete actions
Projects that do not use Tencent Cloud COS
steps: Set the COS secret ID, secret key, region and bucket as environment variables, or run `scripts/setup.sh --from-env`, using sub-account keys with COS-only access.
Run `node scripts/cos_node.mjs <action>` for storage actions such as `upload`, `list` and `sign-url`.
Before a CI task, run `ci-service-status` with `--required-service` to check whether that service is enabled on the bucket.
Run the processing action, for example `image-thumbnail`, `create-doc-to-pdf-job` or `audit-image`.
Use `scripts/ci_api.mjs` for read-only dataset queries and `scripts/preview_gen.mjs` to build an HTML preview of search results.
Set `KIKI=1` to switch to strict mode, which hides delete actions and local credential commands.

zh.tagline: 腾讯云COS存储与数据万象处理
zh.summary: 这个技能为开发者提供一个入口，用于管理腾讯云对象存储（COS）并调用数据万象（CI）能力。覆盖文件和存储桶管理、图片、文档、媒体、内容审核、语音和知识库等任务。它以 Node.js 脚本运行，输出 JSON。
problem: 把文件放在腾讯云 COS 中的团队，常常不只需要上传和下载。他们还需要图片缩放、文档转换、内容审核、语音识别，或者对已存文件做检索。这些功能分别对应不同的 COS 和数据万象接口。
使用这个技能后，存储和数据万象任务通过同一组脚本执行，并共用一套凭证。执行数据万象任务前，技能会先检查该存储桶是否已开通对应服务。
fit: 在脚本或智能体中管理 COS 的对象和存储桶
对已存图片做缩放、裁剪、加水印或格式转换
把办公文档转为 PDF 或做在线预览
在数据集中检索已建索引的图片、视频或文档
unfit: 需要在严格模式（KIKI=1）下删除对象或存储桶，严格模式会禁止所有删除操作
不使用腾讯云 COS 的项目
steps: 将 COS 的 SecretId、SecretKey、地域和存储桶配置为环境变量，或运行 `scripts/setup.sh --from-env`；应使用仅有 COS 权限的子账号密钥。
对于 `upload`、`list`、`sign-url` 等存储操作，运行 `node scripts/cos_node.mjs <action>`。
执行数据万象任务前，用 `--required-service` 运行 `ci-service-status`，确认该存储桶已开通所需服务。
运行对应的处理操作，例如 `image-thumbnail`、`create-doc-to-pdf-job` 或 `audit-image`。
用 `scripts/ci_api.mjs` 做只读的数据集查询，用 `scripts/preview_gen.mjs` 为检索结果生成 HTML 预览。
设置 `KIKI=1` 进入严格模式，此时删除类操作和本地凭证管理命令会被隐藏。
